ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 40:60 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity dark/shadowed pixels across the visible ventral fluke surface.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Concentrated high-contrast, textured clusters localized on the extreme distal tips of both lobes and distributed along the peaks of the trailing edge serrations.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple parallel, low-contrast linear disruptions detected on the right lobe ventral surface, oriented diagonally toward the median notch.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy barnacle colonization visible as irregular, textured protrusions along the entire trailing edge boundary and both distal tips.
other_distinctive_markers: Asymmetric trailing edge morphology; the right lobe distal tip is significantly more bulbous and heavily textured compared to the tapered left lobe tip.
